source_title: CLIProxyAPI: Route CLI Agents Through Proxy API

discovered_urls.context: Primary repo for CLIProxyAPI — Go proxy server providing OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex-compatible API endpoints for CLI agents; 18.8K stars (MIT); multi-account load balancing, OAuth flows, streaming, function calling, multimodal; v6.8.55; 15+ derivative apps in ecosystem
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 7/10 relevance — formalizes the CLI-agent-through-proxy pattern that underpins Claude Max arbitrage economics. Multi-account round-robin load balancing directly applicable to parallel tmux agent spawns. Compare with LiteLLM (API-native) vs CLIProxyAPI (CLI-agent-native). Worth a dedicated infrastructure/cliproxyapi.md catalogue entry.
